Threading vs. Eventlet: Key Differences
=======================================

| Aspect                | Threading Backend                                      | Eventlet Backend                                       |
|-----------------------|------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| **Concurrency Model** | Uses native threads for concurrency                  | Uses greenlets (lightweight coroutines) for concurrency |
| **Resource Utilization** | High resource utilization due to context switching   | Lower resource utilization due to cooperative multitasking |
